description.content: Upload Python package distributions to the Python Package Index.

Uploads a Python package distribution file (source distribution or wheel) to PyPI. The request must use multipart/form-data encoding and include the distribution file as the content part along with package metadata as form fields. Authentication is required via HTTP Basic Auth using the username __token__ and an API token as the password, or via a short-lived token obtained through Trusted Publishing. PEP 740 attestations may optionally be attached for supply chain integrity verification.

(Required) The distribution file to upload, sent as application/octet-stream.
(Required) The type of distribution being uploaded. (This can only be one of sdist,bdist_wheel,bdist_egg)
(Required) The name of the Python package being uploaded.
(Required) The version string of the release being uploaded.
The version of the metadata standard used.
A one-line summary of the package.
The full description of the package.
The content type of the description, such as text/markdown.
The name of the package author.
The email address of the package author.
The license text or identifier for the package.
Comma-separated keywords for the package.
Trove classifiers for the package. Multiple values are sent as repeated form fields.
The URL of the package home page.
The Python version requirement specifier.
PEP 508 dependency specifiers. Multiple values are sent as repeated form fields.
Optional extra dependency groups provided by the package. Multiple values are sent as repeated form fields.
Project-related URLs as label=URL pairs.
The SHA-256 hash digest of the uploaded file for verification.
The MD5 hash digest of the uploaded file. Deprecated.
The BLAKE2b-256 hash digest of the uploaded file for verification.
An optional PGP signature for the file. Deprecated.
A JSON-encoded string containing PEP 740 digital attestations for the distribution file. PyPI will verify these attestations before accepting the upload.

The PyPI Upload API is the endpoint used by tools like twine and build frontends to publish Python package distributions to the Python Package Index. Served at upload.pypi.org, it emulates the legacy PyPI upload interface and accepts source distributions and wheel files along with their metadata via multipart form data. The API also supports attaching PEP 740 digital attestations to uploads, which PyPI will verify before accepting. Authentication is handled via API tokens or Trusted Publishing workflows using OpenID Connect.
